hook: Reis-Filho built his career deciphering cancer genomics at the bench, at the Institute of Cancer Research and then as Chief of Experimental Pathology at Memorial Sloan Kettering, before moving to AstraZeneca to apply AI foundation models and agentic frameworks directly to drug discovery and clinical development, one of the clearer examples of a working oncologist becoming an enterprise AI leader.
name: Jorge Reis-Filho

quote.text: Our focus includes developing advanced foundation models and agentic frameworks, strategically crucial technologies aligned with AstraZeneca's bold ambition.
quote.context: Jorge Reis-Filho, personal LinkedIn profile summary

moniker: Chief of AI for Science Innovation at AstraZeneca

reading.body:
Jorge Reis-Filho is one of the clearest cases of a research oncologist converting deep bench science into enterprise AI leadership, moving from experimental pathology at Memorial Sloan Kettering to directing foundation model deployment at AstraZeneca within two years.

The trajectory runs from molecular pathology in 2006 through cancer genomics, biomarker development, and computational pathology advising, arriving at a role whose explicit mandate is foundation models and agentic frameworks for drug discovery. Each step added a layer: biological expertise first, then big data integration at Memorial Sloan Kettering, then biomarker validation inside a pharmaceutical pipeline, then AI systems leadership. The 2023-to-2025 interval at AstraZeneca, moving from VP of Cancer Biomarker Development to Chief of AI for Science Innovation, suggests the company reorganized around AI fast enough to create that role from within existing talent rather than hiring externally.

His advisory work at Paige.AI is relevant context. Computational pathology applies machine learning to tissue imaging at scale, and the FDA clearance noted in the data marks a point where AI in pathology crossed from research into regulated clinical use. That experience, alongside the genomics and biomarker work, is the specific combination a pharmaceutical company building agentic drug discovery systems would want at the head of it.

The data does not cover the size of AstraZeneca's AI infrastructure, its compute commitments, or how foundation model training and inference are resourced internally. The record here is a career record, not an operational one, and the connection between Reis-Filho's scientific direction and the underlying compute and power requirements that would execute it lies outside what this data can support.

achievements.title: Chief of AI for Science Innovation, AstraZeneca (2025-present)

achievements.title: Chief, Experimental Pathology, Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center (2016-2023)

achievements.title: Vice President, Cancer Biomarker Development, AstraZeneca

achievements.title: Professor and Chair of Molecular Pathology, The Institute of Cancer Research
achievements.impact: Led a molecular pathology research program studying intra-tumor genetic heterogeneity and DNA repair deficiencies in cancer.
